KNOWLEDGE OF CHILDHOOD AND ADULT IMMUNISATION AMONG CAREGIVERS OF CHILDREN UNDER FIVE IN RURAL AND URBAN COMMUNITIES OF THE EASTERN REGION, GHANA: A COMPARATIVE CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
abstractText: Caregivers' knowledge of the immunisation schedule shapes whether children are presented for each dose and whether adults seek recommended vaccines, yet rural–urban differences in this knowledge have not been examined across childhood and adult vaccination within one design in Ghana. This study assessed and compared knowledge of immunisation among caregivers of children under five years in rural and urban communities of the Eastern Region. A comparative cross-sectional survey enrolled 1,400 caregivers, 700 in each arm, by multistage sampling of two rural and two urban districts. Knowledge was measured with 14 binary items (score 0–14). Arms were compared using Welch's t test, Cohen's d, chi-square and trend tests, a proportional-odds model and item-level risk differences, with false-discovery-rate and design-effect corrections. Mean knowledge was 6.78 (SD 2.59) in rural and 7.87 (SD 2.41) in urban respondents, a difference of 1.09 points (95% CI 0.83–1.35; d = 0.44). Poor knowledge was recorded for 61.0% of rural and 43.4% of urban respondents, and urban residence was associated with higher odds of a better knowledge category (proportional-odds OR 2.02; 95% CI 1.65–2.49). Urban respondents answered all 14 items correctly more often, by 4.9 to 11.3 percentage points; 13 differences were significant, all of which survived false-discovery-rate correction and 10 of which survived design-effect correction. The largest gaps concerned adult and maternal vaccination, and the weakest knowledge in both arms concerned operational facts: that routine vaccines are free (38.1% rural, 44.1% urban), that a mild illness does not preclude vaccination, and where and when a child should be vaccinated. Within each arm, knowledge level was not associated with willingness to vaccinate or with receipt of the third pentavalent dose, and stratification by knowledge left the rural–urban gap in willingness unchanged (OR 3.01 before and after). Knowledge of immunisation was modest in both settings and consistently lower in rural communities. Health education should prioritise operational information on cost, timing, eligibility and place of vaccination, particularly in rural communities, alongside measures that address access and confidence.

Population consolidation and head-starting as demographic rescue of a low-density gopher tortoise population
abstractText: Context Gopher tortoises, Gopherus polyphemus, are a keystone species of south-eastern North America due to their historically high density, grazing habits, and the burrows that they maintain across upland landscapes. Many gopher tortoise populations are demographically non-viable due to low population density and/or population size. Management for this species frequently utilize measures such as translocation and head-starting. Aims Between 2020 and 2024, we used short-distance translocation to consolidate a low-density resident population of gopher tortoises and monitored spatial biology and apparent survival in the translocated animals immediately following translocation. We also conducted head-starting of tortoises collected as eggs from the same site and manipulated head-start release conditions to test whether soft- versus hard-release affected apparent survival. Methods We tracked both wild and head-started tortoises via radiotelemetry for 1 year during and 1 year after penning; we determined apparent survival by direct observation of individuals remaining alive and within the site approximately 1.5 years after all enclosure pens had been removed. Key results Home ranges of free-ranging tortoises were approximately the same in the enclosure pen as they were after the enclosure pen was removed, but apparent survival of free-ranging tortoises at the study site was only 56% after the enclosure was removed. Male adult tortoises had higher apparent survival in the site than did females, and translocation distance was a negative predictor of apparent survival. Release condition did not affect head-started tortoise apparent survival, and overall apparent survival of head-started tortoises was 70% 2 years after release. Conclusions Head-starting and direct hard release of juveniles are likely to be successful tools for gopher tortoise conservation, whereas population consolidation may cause poor adult survival and/or site fidelity. Implications Short-distance translocations of wildlife populations should be further studied before this tool is more broadly applied in conservation projects.

abstractText: Aims Various techniques have been described to manage massive acetabular bone loss in revision hip arthroplasty. The aMace system has gained popularity due to its custom design, which aims to restore the hip centre of rotation and provide initial mechanical stability in cases of large, non-contained defects. This study aimed to assess the short- and mid-term outcomes of patients who underwent revision surgery using the aMace system. Methods A retrospective review was conducted of all patients who underwent aMace implantation at two revision centres between June 2013 and October 2022, with a minimum follow-up of 12 months. Data collected included demographic details, indications for surgery, bone loss classification, reconstruction details, reoperations, complications, and functional outcomes. Results A total of 52 patients underwent revision surgery, with a median follow-up of 51 months (IQR 36 to 72). The mean age was 72.9 years (40 to 87), and 86.5% (45/52) of patients were female. The mean BMI was 25.3 kg/m² (18.2 to 34.7), and the mean American Society of Anesthesiologists grade was III. Most patients had Paprosky type 3B 65.3% (34/52) or 3A 34.6% (18/52) defects. The main indications for revision were aseptic loosening 69.2% (36/52), infection 15.3% (8/52), and periprosthetic fracture 13.4% (7/52). Single-stage revision was performed in 76.9% (40/52), and 67.3% (35/52) underwent both cup and femoral component revision. Dual-mobility bearings were used in 76.9% (40/52) of cases, including 90% (36/40) of single-stage revisions, and 86.5% (45/52) had a metal-on-polyethylene articulation. No aMace components were revised. The 30-day mortality rate was 1.9% (1/52). The overall reoperation rate was 5.7% (3/52), primarily for periprosthetic femoral fracture and dislocation. Leg length discrepancy occurred in 9.6% (5/52). Two cases of sciatic nerve palsy were transient and resolved during follow-up. Statistically significant improvements in pain and mobility were observed (p < 0.001). Conclusion Our findings support the aMace system for significant acetabular bone loss and pelvic discontinuity, with satisfactory mid-term outcomes and low complications. We recommend these procedures in specialist centres with multidisciplinary team involvement. Cite this article: Bone Jt Open 2026;7(10):1375–1383.

abstractText: Stres akademik yang dialami mahasiswa tingkat akhir menuntut adanya strategi pengelolaan emosi, salah satunya melalui pemanfaatan musik sebagai saluran komunikasi intrapersonal. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan proses komunikasi intrapersonal melalui musik dalam menurunkan stres akademik pada mahasiswa Ilmu Komunikasi Universitas Malikussaleh angkatan 2022, khususnya selama penyusunan skripsi. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain fenomenologi. Informan berjumlah lima mahasiswa yang dipilih melalui teknik purposive sampling berdasarkan pengalaman mengalami stres akademik dan kebiasaan mendengarkan musik untuk mengelola emosi. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara mendalam, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis melalui transkripsi verbatim, horizontalization, pengelompokan makna, serta sintesis esensi pengalaman. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa mahasiswa secara sadar memilih musik sesuai kebutuhan emosional melalui empat tahapan Mood Management Theory, yaitu potensi rangsangan, valensi hedonik, afinitas semantik, dan potensi penyerapan. Musik berfungsi melalui dua aspek utama, yakni afirmasi yang membantu membangun self-talk positif dan motivasi melalui pemaknaan lirik, serta relaksasi melalui ritme, tempo, melodi, dan instrumen. Proses tersebut menghasilkan respons sensori, kognitif, dan behavioral yang mendukung pemulihan diri dan kembalinya mahasiswa pada aktivitas penyusunan skripsi. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa musik menjadi saluran komunikasi intrapersonal yang mendukung penurunan stres akademik secara subjektif sesuai kondisi dan kebutuhan emosional mahasiswa.

title: Reconstruction of the Indonesian National Police Code of Ethics Commission's Procedural Law in Realizing the Principles of Fast and Efficient Justice
abstractText: Enforcing the Indonesian National Police (Polri) code of ethics is a crucial instrument for maintaining the professionalism, integrity, and legitimacy of the Indonesian National Police (Polri). However, in practice, case resolution through the Indonesian National Police Code of Ethics Commission (KKEP) still faces various obstacles, including slow, lengthy processes, and suboptimal implementation of the principles of speedy and efficient justice. This study aims to analyze the current mechanism for resolving cases under the Polri Code of Ethics and examine the factors that cause inefficiency, while also formulating an ideal reconstruction of the KKEP procedural law. This study uses a normative legal research method with a statutory regulatory approach, a conceptual approach, and a case approach. The results indicate that the inefficiency in resolving cases under the Polri Code of Ethics is influenced by the complexity of internal bureaucracy, the absence of rigid time limits for each stage of the examination, weak integration of digital administration, and overlapping administrative and ethical authorities. Reconstruction of the KKEP procedural law needs to be directed at strengthening the principle of due process of law, which still guarantees speed, simplicity, and low costs through time limits for examinations, digitizing case administration, simplifying trial stages, and strengthening internal oversight mechanisms. This reformulation is expected to increase the effectiveness of enforcing the code of ethics while strengthening public trust in the National Police institution.

abstractText: Indonesia’s legal pluralism requires law students to develop comparative analytical skills to understand the similarities, differences, and applications of various customary law systems. However, these skills still require strengthening through systematic learning. This study aims to assess and develop the comparative analytical skills of fifth-semester students in the Law Study Program at Universitas Islam Sumatera Utara in the Customary Law course. The study employed a quantitative approach using a one-group pretest–posttest pre-experimental design. All nine fifth-semester students from Class C in the 2026/1 academic year were included through total sampling. The research instrument was a comparative analytical test covering the identification of characteristics, analysis of similarities and differences, evaluation of strengths and weaknesses, and synthesis of customary law systems within the context of Indonesian legal pluralism. Expert validation yielded an average validity index of 0.87. Data were analyzed using the Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test and N-Gain. The results revealed a significant improvement in comparative analytical skills (Z = −2.67; p = 0.008), with an N-Gain of 0.63 (moderate category). These findings indicate the potential of systematic comparative learning to strengthen students’ customary law reasoning. The study recommends enhancing cross-system customary law analysis, particularly in understanding the relationships among legal norms, institutions, and community practices, although its causal effectiveness requires further examination using a comparison group.

title: The rapid delivery of RNase H variants reveals distinct classes of RNA:DNA hybrids
abstractText: Abstract Multiple lines of evidence suggest that RNase H1-sensitive RNA:DNA hybrids could disrupt the stability and restart of stalled replication forks. The prolonged over-expression of RNase H1 is the most popular method to manipulate RNA:DNA hybrids in situ but it cannot discriminate between direct and indirect effects resulting from their loss. To overcome this limitation, we developed iCoRD (in Cellulo RNase H Delivery) to rapidly deliver comparable amounts of either Escherichia coli RNase H1 (RnhA) or control proteins in live cells, with a negligible impact on the transcriptome. iCoRD -delivered RnhA recognises RNA:DNA hybrids in situ, is enriched in the vicinity of active replication forks and rescues replication fork progression in different stress conditions. While iCoRD -delivered RnhA had a clear impact on stress-induced, fork-proximal RNA:DNA hybrids and R-ChIP signals, it had no effect on DRIP or S9.6 Cut&Tag signals, even when these were induced by stress. Our results strongly suggest the existence of distinct populations of RNA:DNA hybrids that are best mapped by different methods and are differently sensitive to RNase H1 activity in situ.

Synthesis of Reliable Logic Question Answering Data for Large Language Model with Aid of Operations Research Program
abstractText: Logical reasoning is a highly valued capability in language models. However, high-quality logical reasoning data remain scarce, while manual data creation is costly and time-consuming. We introduce Operations Research Aided Synthesis (ORAS), a solver-verified, two-layer incremental framework for synthesizing logic question-answering data. ORAS leverages operations research techniques to systematically generate high-quality datasets for evaluating large language models (LLMs) and, when used for training, improving their reasoning capabilities. ORAS's pipeline integrates mathematical programming methods to generate question-answer pairs, and then employs a dual-phase approach: the first phase uses optimization algorithms to construct and evaluate the logic systems by solving the problem using a mathematical solver. The second phase translates the logic system to human-readable problems and generates answers according to the information from the mathematical solver. The fine-tuned model achieves a 22%-33% (percentage point) improvement in accuracy on in-sample tests and a 4%-22% (percentage point) improvement on similar out-of-sample tests.

abstractText: Learning mathematics, especially measuring weight and standard units, remains difficult for third-grade students, and less varied instruction leaves them passive. This study aimed to determine the effect of the Project Based Learning (PjBL) model on the mathematics learning outcomes of third-grade students at UPTD SDN Telagabiru 1. It was a quantitative quasi-experimental study with a posttest-only control group design. The subjects were 43 students: 22 students of class III A in the experimental class (PjBL) and 21 students of class III B in the control class (conventional learning). Data were collected through a learning outcome test and analyzed using the Shapiro-Wilk test, Levene's test, and an independent sample t-test. The mean score of the experimental class (75.32) was higher than that of the control class (66.05). The data were normally distributed and homogeneous, and the t-test yielded a calculated t of 4.644, greater than the t table value of 2.020, with a significance value below 0.001. Therefore, PjBL had a significant effect on students' mathematics learning outcomes.

title: Carnivorous marsupials as model systems: four decades of ecological insights from Chris Dickman’s dasyurid research
abstractText: Australia’s dasyurid marsupials comprise an ecologically diverse radiation of predators whose variation in body size, habitat use, diet and life-history strategies has made them powerful model systems for ecological research. Over more than four decades, Chris Dickman used dasyurids to address fundamental questions concerning competition, species coexistence, population dynamics and resource limitation, reproductive strategies, community assembly and environmental variability. His early research on Antechinus transformed Australian mammal ecology beyond descriptive natural history. He used manipulative field experiments to demonstrate asymmetric interspecific competition and identify behavioural interference, food limitation and resource partitioning as mechanisms promoting coexistence. Subsequent studies linked photoperiodic regulation of reproduction, multiple paternity and sexual selection to the evolution of male semelparity, while ecological and genetic studies revealed previously unrecognised biodiversity, culminating in the description of Antechinus agilis. Chris later expanded the spatial and conceptual scale of his research from interactions between closely related species to the organisation of whole communities and predator guilds. Comparative studies of arid-zone dasyurids demonstrated species-specific responses to habitat and climatic gradients, while long-term monitoring in the Simpson Desert revealed contrasting demographic responses to rainfall, temperature and vegetation across successive boom-and-bust cycles. The work using the Simpson Desert system ultimately extended ecological theory beyond mammalian interactions to competition between dasyurids and insectivorous reptiles. Collectively, Chris’ research established dasyurids as internationally important model systems and demonstrated how rigorous field experimentation, comparative ecology and long-term ecological monitoring can link natural history with ecological theory across multiple spatial and temporal scales. His work continues to provide an enduring conceptual framework for understanding ecological processes and conserving Australia’s unique carnivorous marsupials in a rapidly changing environment.

title: Spin-Phonon Relaxation and Decoherence in a Three-Dimensional Paired-Ion Framework Composed of Vanadyl Porphyrin Qubits
abstractText: Abstract Molecular electron spin qubits are an emerging platform for quantum technologies due to their atomic-scale synthetic tunability. Supramolecular structures can also place these qubits at precise positions within ordered arrays, allowing the scale-up of qubit architectures through a bottom-up approach. Here, we introduce the first three-dimensional paired-ion framework (PIF), VO-3D-PIF-1, which is composed of a concentrated array of S = 1/2 vanadyl porphyrin spin qubits arranged by ionic lattice interactions. The PIF was characterized using electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy to demonstrate the impact of framework structure and spin density on spin–lattice relaxation (T1) and spin decoherence (Tm). The high vanadyl porphyrin spin density within the framework (0.125 spins/nm3) promotes dipolar-driven decoherence, with Tm = 200–400 ns over a temperature range of 140–5 K. Spin–lattice relaxation mirrors that of vanadyl porphyrins in dilute solution, suggesting that the weak ionic interactions assembling the porphyrins within the secondary coordination sphere do not adversely affect phonon-induced T1 relaxation.

Realizing giant photodielectric effect in Bi 5 Ti 3 Fe 1- x Cr x O 15 solid-solution ceramics by dual-phase structure
abstractText: Abstract Light control of dielectric properties of ferroelectrics is crucial for the development of photoelectric devices. A giant photodielectric effect Δ ε r ~ 7.4% was achieved in continuous-component solid-solution ceramics Bi 5 Ti 3 Fe 1- x Cr x O 15 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1) with a dual-phase structure. The decreasing phase fraction of the high-symmetry Fmm 2 phase/low-symmetry A2 1 am phase induces a linearly narrowing bandgap and improves visible-light absorption. The light-triggered “on-off” switchable photocurrent and the released electron-hole pairs at the phase boundary contribute to the excellent photodielectric effect. Finite element simulations confirmed that microsphere grains play a critical role in generation of photocarriers and photocurrent. These results demonstrate that the dual-phase structure can boost the photoelectric response, endowing potential applications of photodielectric devices.

title: Enhanced Facial Micro Emotion Detection using Optimized Temporal Attention Recurrent Graph Convolutional Neural Network
abstractText: Micro-expressions are brief natural facial expressions that reveal concealed emotions. However, traditional facial expression recognition (FER) methods struggled due to minute expression variations, limited dataset availability, and difference in lighting and camera angles, which complicates the classification process. Hence, this research proposes an Enhanced Facial Micro Emotion Detection using Optimized Temporal Attention Recurrent Graph Convolutional Neural Network (EFED-TARGCN), which effectively recognizes minute facial expressions. The framework integrates Low Dynamic Range Histogram Equalization (LDR-HE) for image enhancement, Revised Tunable Q-Factor Wavelet Transform (RTQWT) for spatial-temporal feature extraction, and Variable Velocity Strategy Particle Swarm Optimization (VVS-PSO) for relevant feature selection. Unlike conventional approaches that lack adaptive optimization, the proposed method introduces a Wolf-Bird Optimizer (WBO) to dynamically tune TARGCN parameters, enabling precise recognition of micro-expressions. The proposed method is implemented in python and evaluated using SMIC_preprocessed and SAMM v3 Datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed models attain higher accuracy of 99.47% on the SMIC_preprocessed dataset and 20.28%, 28.22% and 29.27% on the SAMM v3 Dataset compared with existing models. The proposed framework provides an effective solution for facial micro-expression recognition with potential applications in deception detection, psychological assessment, intelligent security systems and human-computer interaction.

abstractText: This study aims to formulate a conceptual model of digital transformation in human resource management (HRM) that places honesty as a fundamental principle in managing tasks, reporting, communication, and evaluation within educational institutions. The study presents a preliminary Research and Development (R&D) design based on the ADDIE model, consisting of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. Subsequent data collection is planned through needs analysis, expert assessments, practicality questionnaires, observations, and user interviews. The study produces a conceptual framework integrating digital recordkeeping, evidence verification, communication and feedback, data correction, and continuous evaluation. The framework incorporates honesty indicators, including information accuracy, responsible transparency, consistency between reports and supporting evidence, willingness to correct errors, and accountability for decisions. The proposed model also includes user access controls, data modification tracking, and periodic report review mechanisms. The novelty of this study lies in translating honesty values into traceable digital work procedures while incorporating human clarification mechanisms to prevent administrative errors from being automatically interpreted as dishonesty. Since expert validation and field testing have not yet been conducted, the model's feasibility, practicality, and effectiveness remain unverified. Further research is required to validate and test the proposed model with relevant users and experts.

title: ANALISIS PERAN GURU DALAM MENANAMKAN SIKAP EMPATI KEPADA PESERTA DIDIK MELALUI PEMBELAJARAN PENDIDIKAN PANCASILA DI KELAS V SD
abstractText: ABSTRACT Cultivating empathy in elementary schools requires learning practices that not only convey moral values but also provide opportunities for students to apply them in their daily interactions. This study aims to describe teachers’ efforts, school support, and the challenges encountered in cultivating empathy through Pancasila Education in Grade V at UPTD SD Negeri 077272 Lolofaoso Tabaloho. The study employed a qualitative approach with a descriptive method. The informants consisted of the school principal, the Grade V teacher, and three students selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, then analyzed through data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. Data trustworthiness was examined using source and technique triangulation. The findings identified five teacher strategies: role modeling, positive behavioral habituation, collaborative learning, advice and reinforcement, and the creation of a supportive learning environment. These practices were reinforced by school culture and cooperation with parents. Students demonstrated empathetic behaviors through caring, mutual respect, willingness to help, and cooperation, although differences in individual characteristics, environmental influences, and limited instructional time remained challenges. The study concludes that empathy cultivation is implemented through the integration of teachers’ practices and support from the school environment, with students’ behaviors serving as indicators of how empathetic values are applied in everyday life. ABSTRAK Penanaman empati di sekolah dasar memerlukan praktik pembelajaran yang tidak hanya menyampaikan nilai moral, tetapi juga memberi ruang bagi peserta didik untuk menerapkannya dalam interaksi sehari-hari. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan upaya guru, dukungan sekolah, serta kendala dalam menanamkan sikap empati melalui pembelajaran Pendidikan Pancasila di kelas V UPTD SD Negeri 077272 Lolofaoso Tabaloho. Perilaku empatik peserta didik terlihat melalui kepedulian, sikap saling menghargai, kesediaan membantu, dan kemampuan bekerja sama, meskipun perbedaan karakter, pengaruh lingkungan, serta keterbatasan waktu masih menjadi kendala. abstractText: Pengelolaan limbah organik rumah tangga yang tidak optimal menjadi salah satu faktor yang memperburuk kualitas lingkungan dan menghambat upaya ketahanan pangan di tingkat rumah tangga. Eco-enzyme merupakan solusi sederhana dan ramah lingkungan untuk mengolah limbah organik menjadi produk yang bermanfaat, seperti pupuk cair alami. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan dan kesadaran anggota PKK Desa Sembunganyar dalam mengelola limbah rumah tangga melalui pelatihan pembuatan eco-enzyme guna mendukung ketahanan pangan berkelanjutan. Mitra dalam kegiatan ini adalah kelompok PKK yang memiliki peran strategis dalam pengelolaan lingkungan dan pemberdayaan rumah tangga. Metode yang digunakan berupa penyuluhan mengenai ketahanan pangan dan manfaat eco-enzyme, demonstrasi praktik pembuatan oleh tim pengabdi, serta pembagian brosur panduan dan produk eco-enzyme hasil fermentasi kepada peserta. Evaluasi dilakukan melalui pengisian kuesioner setelah kegiatan. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan ini berhasil meningkatkan pemahaman peserta terhadap pentingnya pengelolaan limbah organik dan membangun motivasi awal untuk mencoba praktik secara mandiri. Meskipun peserta belum terlibat dalam praktik langsung, respons yang diberikan mencerminkan ketertarikan terhadap penerapan eco-enzyme dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Hasil pengabdian ini menunjukkan bahwa edukasi berbasis visual dan demonstratif dapat menjadi strategi efektif dalam membangun kesadaran lingkungan pada tingkat komunitas. Pentingnya kegiatan ini terletak pada potensinya dalam memperkuat peran perempuan desa dalam menciptakan solusi lingkungan yang aplikatif dan mendukung kemandirian pangan rumah tangga.

title: UP3D: Utilizing Pseudo Points to Enhance 3D Object Detection
abstractText: LiDAR-based 3D object detection is a critical engineering component in autonomous driving systems, yet its performance is fundamentally constrained by the sparsity and range-dependent density of point clouds, especially under sparse LiDAR observations caused by increasing sensing distance. Pseudo point assisted approaches alleviate this limitation by lifting image pixels into 3D space via depth completion; however, most existing methods exploit pseudo points at only a single stage of a two-stage detection pipeline, which restricts their ability to consistently complement sparse LiDAR observations. In this paper, we propose UP3D, a pseudo point assisted 3D object detection framework that integrates pseudo points into both the proposal generation and refinement stages in a stage-aware fashion. By leveraging pseudo points throughout the detection pipeline, UP3D densifies sparse LiDAR observations at the proposal stage to mitigate range-dependent point sparsity, and introduces complementary geometric cues at the RoI refinement stage for accurate localization, while maintaining computational efficiency through carefully designed pseudo point processing strategies. Experiments demonstrate that UP3D achieves competitive detection accuracy with favorable efficiency, validating the effectiveness of stage-aware pseudo point integration. abstractText: Abstract Efficient adsorption of DNA onto metal nanoparticle surfaces is essential for an SERS-based structural analysis. However, the negative surface charge of commonly used nanoparticles promotes electrostatic repulsion with DNA, limiting adsorption and SERS enhancement and often requiring the use of aggregating agents. As Raman enhancement depends not only on the nanoparticle charge but also on the nanoparticle morphology, composition, and surface chemistry, systematic evaluation of nanoparticles with diverse physicochemical properties is necessary to identify optimal conditions for DNA adsorption and SERS detection. Metallic nanoparticles differing in metal (silver or gold), surface charge (positive or negative), and shape (spheres or stars) were synthesized by chemical reduction. To eliminate residual synthesis species, silver and gold nanospheres were also prepared by pulsed-laser ablation in liquid (PLAL). Eight nanoparticle types were characterized by UV/vis/NIR absorption spectroscopy, electrophoretic and dynamic light scattering, and scanning electron microscopy. Their SERS performance for DNA structural analysis was evaluated using the human telomeric sequence d[(TTAGGG)4] (Tel24), which adopted an antiparallel G-quadruplex (G4) in the presence of sodium ions (100 mmol/L), enabling comparison of nonfolded and folded DNA. SERS spectra were recorded with 532 and 785 nm excitation. Circular dichroism spectroscopy was used to confirm the DNA structures. Negatively charged citrate-stabilized silver and gold nanospheres (AgNP_cit and AuNP_cit) and silver nanostars (AgNS_cit) produced the most intense and structurally informative SERS spectra. Spectral markers, including shifts of guanine bands associated with Hoogsteen hydrogen bonding, bands assigned to G-tetrads and d(TTA) loops, and changes in adenine and guanine ring-breathing band intensities, clearly distinguished nonfolded from G4 DNA. The adenine-to-guanine intensity ratio (IdA/IdG) proved to be particularly sensitive to G4 formation. Despite being free of residual surface species, PLAL-prepared nanoparticles (AgNP_PLAL and AuNP_PLAL) showed a substantially weaker SERS enhancement. Likewise, positively charged spermine-coated nanoparticles (AgNP_sp and AuNP_sp) performed poorly, despite favorable electrostatic interactions with DNA. Near-infrared excitation (785 nm) was superior to 532 nm as visible excitation often produced interfering signals or no detectable spectra. Overall, citrate-stabilized silver nanospheres exhibited the best performance, providing reliable and intense SERS detection of both nonfolded and G-quadruplex Tel24. These findings provided practical guidelines for selecting SERS substrates and excitation wavelengths for distinguishing nonfolded DNA from G4 structures.

title: Traveling among the giants: a revision of Marres Walker (Hymenoptera, Chalcididae, Cratocentrinae) with the description of Marres copelandi sp. nov. from Kenya
abstractText: The genus Marres Walker (Hymenoptera: Chalcididae: Cratocentrinae) is reviewed and Marres copelandi Delvare sp. nov. is described from Kenya. Individuals of Marres are among the largest of chalcidoid wasps, yet are among the rarest in collections. The genus and its three included species, M. copelandi, M. dicomas Walker and M. kerrichi (Steffan) comb. nov., are diagnosed and illustrated through photomicrography. The phylogenetic relationships between Cratocentrinae and other Chalcidoidea and between Marres and the other genera of Cratocentrinae are discussed.

title: Flexible Triboelectric Nanogenerator Based on PAN/PTFE Nanofibers and BaTiO3/PDMS Composite Films for Wearable Applications
abstractText: Abstract The rapid development of flexible electronics and wearable technologies has created an urgent need for triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) that combine high electrical output, mechanical robustness, and conformal flexibility. However, achieving this combination through rational materials design remains challenging. Herein, a flexible TENG is developed through composite tribolayer engineering, using a PAN/PTFE composite nanofiber membrane as the positive tribolayer and a BaTiO3/PDMS composite film as the negative tribolayer. Electrospinning and solution casting were integrated to regulate the tribolayer microstructure and functional response. The PAN/PTFE nanofibrous membrane containing 0.5 wt % PTFE exhibited the highest tensile strength of approximately 1.36 MPa, whereas the 12 wt % PAN/1.0 wt % PTFE composition was selected for optimal electrical output. The 2 wt % BaTiO3/PDMS composite film provided the highest triboelectric output among the investigated BaTiO3 loadings. SEM, XRD, XPS, and SEM–EDS analyses provided complementary information regarding composite morphology, crystalline characteristics, and filler incorporation. Under optimized conditions, the TENG delivered an open-circuit voltage of approximately ±60 V and a short-circuit current of approximately ±0.5 μA in the periodic contact–separation mode under a contact force of 5 N at 1 Hz, with stable responses over different driving frequencies. The highest peak output power and power density within the investigated load-resistance range reached 27.59 μW and 11.04 mW m–2, respectively. Numerical simulations and additional separation-distance measurements showed qualitatively consistent trends in the electrostatic response of the device. Moreover, repeated foot-stepping experiments produced reproducible voltage signals, demonstrating the feasibility of biomechanical energy harvesting under wearable-like conditions. This work provides insights into the relationships among composite composition, microstructure, mechanical properties, and electrical output, supporting the further development of flexible TENGs for wearable energy-harvesting applications.

title: Pelatihan dan Simulasi Keselamatan Kerja di Bengkel Teknik Konstruksi Kapal Baja bagi Siswa SMK Maskumambang 1 Dukun
abstractText: Lingkungan pendidikan, khususnya SMK, merupakan tempat berlangsungnya berbagai aktivitas yang memiliki potensi risiko, terutama dalam praktik kejuruan. Pendidikan kejuruan bertujuan membentuk siswa yang terampil, kompeten, dan memiliki etos kerja tinggi agar siap memasuki dunia industri. Namun, kesalahan manusia dan lingkungan kerja yang tidak aman masih menjadi penyebab utama kecelakaan kerja. Oleh karena itu, keselamatan kerja menjadi aspek penting yang harus diterapkan sejak dini. Meski demikian, kesadaran dan penerapan prosedur keselamatan kerja masih perlu ditingkatkan. Keselamatan kerja mencakup kemampuan mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan mencegah risiko secara sistematis, didukung manajemen risiko dan pengendalian yang efektif. Kecelakaan dapat dicegah melalui kewaspadaan fisik dan mental serta kedisiplinan dalam menjalankan prosedur. Pengetahuan keselamatan juga melindungi siswa dari ancaman hukum dan kerugian material akibat pelanggaran. Siswa perlu memahami tanggung jawab bersama dalam menjaga keselamatan serta memiliki kewaspadaan fisik dan mental. Simulasi keselamatan kerja penting dilakukan agar siswa mampu menerapkan prosedur secara optimal saat praktik. Dengan penguasaan keterampilan keselamatan yang baik, lulusan SMK lebih siap bersaing di dunia kerja dan mampu menghadapi tantangan industri secara profesional.

abstractText: Synalpheus sauron sp. nov. is described based on two male-female pairs, female holotype and male allotype from Athulivaru, Southern Ari Atoll, Maldives, and an additional male-female pair from Nancowry Island, Nicobar Islands, India. The presence of one or two prominent sharp teeth on the proximolateral margin of the antennal scaphocerite is the important diagnostic feature of S. sauron sp. nov., which is otherwise very similar to S. carinatus (De Man, 1888). In addition, in the male allotype, the fourth and fifth pleonites each have a peculiar mid-dorsal hump; this feature is absent in the non-type male from the Nicobar Islands. The Maldivian type specimens were found on an unidentified black feather star at a depth of 30 m, whereas the specimens from the Nicobar Islands were possibly associated with Anneissia bennetti (Müller, 1841) found at a depth of 5.8 m.

title: DETERMINANTS OF PRE-EXPOSURE PROPHYLAXIS (PREP) ADHERENCE AMONG MEN WHO HAVE SEX WITH MEN AT JUMPANDANG BARU PRIMARY HEALTHCARE CENTER: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
abstractText: Background: Globally, HIV transmission occurs predominantly through heterosexual contact, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. However, men who have sex with men (MSM) remain a key population with a high burden of HIV infection, including in Indonesia. Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) has been introduced as an effective strategy for preventing sexually acquired HIV. Its effectiveness depends largely on adherence to the prescribed regimen. Purpose: This study aimed to analyze factors associated with PrEP adherence among MSM at Jumpandang Baru Primary Healthcare Center (Puskesmas Jumpandang Baru). Methods: This quantitative study employed a cross-sectional design. The variables examined included age, educational level, occupation, knowledge, attitude, stigma, social support, and self-efficacy. A total of 130 participants were recruited using accidental sampling, and data were collected through questionnaires. Data were analyzed using Stata, with Pearson’s chi-square test and Fisher’s exact test, as appropriate. Results: Of the 130 respondents, 79 (60.8%) were adherent to PrEP. Occupation (p = 0.008), knowledge (p = 0.008), stigma (p = 0.001), social support (p = 0.001), and self-efficacy (p < 0.001) were significantly associated with PrEP adherence among MSM. Conclusion: Occupation, knowledge, stigma, social support, and self-efficacy were significantly associated with PrEP adherence among MSM at Puskesmas Jumpandang Baru. MSM are encouraged to maintain adherence and communicate regularly with healthcare providers regarding PrEP use. Community health centers should strengthen educational interventions to improve understanding of PrEP and support adherence.

title: PEMBERDAYAAN EKONOMI WARGA MELALUI DIGITALISASI UMKM BERBASIS PELATIHAN LITERASI DIGITAL DI KELURAHAN KREMBANGAN UTARA
abstractText: Program pendampingan digitalisasi UMKM di Kelurahan Krembangan Utara, Surabaya, yang diinisiasi oleh tim KKN 16 UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur, bertujuan untuk meningkatkan literasi digital dan adopsi teknologi di kalangan pelaku usaha mikro. Melalui pendekatan partisipatif berbasis door to door, kegiatan ini mencakup aktivasi layanan digital seperti Google Maps, QRIS, GoFood, dan ShopeeFood. Hasil pelaksanaan menunjukkan respons positif dari pelaku UMKM, yang mulai merasakan manfaat berupa peningkatan visibilitas usaha dan efisiensi transaksi. Kendala yang dihadapi meliputi keterbatasan perangkat dan resistensi kultural terhadap teknologi, terutama di kalangan pelaku usaha lanjut usia. Program ini menekankan pentingnya dukungan berkelanjutan melalui pelatihan rutin, pusat informasi digital, serta keterlibatan kader lokal. Secara keseluruhan, kegiatan ini berkontribusi pada pemberdayaan komunitas dan dapat direplikasi di wilayah lain dengan karakteristik serupa. Kata kunci: Digitalisasi UMKM, pendampingan door to door, literasi digital, transformasi digital, pemberdayaan komunitas
